choices: Only the preregistered material seeds 8000–8015 are analyzed; other seeds, including pilot seeds, are ignored.
An item is identified by (seed, id). Within each (arm, item, cell), 'last record' means the last JSONL occurrence, even if it is invalid; there is no fallback to an earlier valid record.

The cell string and integer D/N/T fields must agree. Inconsistent item truth, malformed identifiers, unexpected arms, or more than 12 observed items in a planned seed cause an error rather than an inferred repair.

A counted judgment requires parse_ok literally true, finish_reason stop or end_turn, and verdict literally true, false, or 'not established'. Missing/null or unrecognized verdicts are failures. 'not established' counts as non-confirmation, including at T0.
answer_chars is deliberately absent from the blinded export and is not required for judgment inclusion. The source audit of this field cannot be reconstructed from judgments.jsonl.
Completeness is joint across both arms and all eight cells at item level. All estimates, including manipulation checks 2 and 3 and the additional descriptive rates, use this same complete-item set.

Failure rates use the fixed planned denominator of 192 judgments per arm and cell, before complete-item exclusion. Missing planned records, including entirely unobserved items, count as failures. The failure threshold is inclusive: at most 5%.

Manipulation check 2 treats only a boolean verdict equal to truth as correct; 'not established' is incorrect. Manipulation check 3 uses the absolute difference between truth-group confirmation rates pooled across all four D1 cells. An undefined check does not pass.

The N/T code-test results in tests/test_e025.py are not present in judgments.jsonl and cannot be inferred from factor labels or model responses. No pass is assumed. A fail-closed convention treats this unverified fourth manipulation check as not passed, so the reported overall manipulation flags are false and inferential labels remain deskriptiv. This is not evidence that the external code tests failed.
No material-ledger exclusions, preflight audits, or external-control results are inferred from missing records. They cannot be independently verified using this input alone.

Bootstrap resampling is over individual complete items, not seeds or individual judgments. Each item's paired contrast is calculated first. K3 resamples only complete truth-true items. Item ordering is ascending (seed, id). Each arm and quantity gets a fresh RNG using the preregistered seed, with 5000 draws.
The E-024 percentile implementation is unavailable. Percentile bounds use linear interpolation at indices (5000 - 1) * 0.025 and (5000 - 1) * 0.975.

The preregistration does not define its one-sided bootstrap-p algorithm. Here p = (1 + number of ordinary, uncentered bootstrap means <= 0) / 5001, with separate RNGs seeded 352 for R1 and 353 for R2. Ties at zero enter the nonpositive tail. This explicitly chooses a bootstrap sign-tail convention, not a null-centered test.
BH includes the four planned arm-by-primary tests regardless of manipulation status or sample-size eligibility. An unestimable test occupies the family with p=1 for adjustment but reports q=null.

Decision rules are evaluated in listed order: supporting label, praktisch null, Vorhersagewert ausgeschlossen, nicht entschieden. Failed/unverified manipulation checks or fewer than 144 complete items override primary labels to deskriptiv, but not estimates, intervals, or computable q-values.
Empty estimands have estimate=null, ci95=[null,null], n=0; an empty primary test has q=null. n counts items, not judgments or seeds.

The requested output schema has no separate fields for the preregistered NE rate, broken-item excerpt confirmations, check diagnostics, or premise warning. These are reported below as per-arm descriptive JSON strings in choices. NE pools the two D1-T1 cells; broken-item confirmations count judgments across all four D1 cells, not distinct items.
